newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end down on position adjustment, hedge sales.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end down on position adjustment, hedge sales.

text.p: The key March Japanese government bond futures contract ended slightly easier on Tuesday on position adjustment by dealers and hedge sales.
Hedge sales of the March by market players who had bought or were planning to buy newly auctioned 20-year JGBs dragged the key futures contract down toward the close, a trust bank trader said.
The Ministry of Finance offered 400 billion yen worth of 3.3 percent 20-year JGBs through an auction on Tuesday.
MOF said the auction produced a lowest price of 99.70 and an average price of 99.76.
